attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The Kinn continue to migrate due to the fires in the south.","reason":"Briefing gives no current update; claiming the movement is ongoing adds detail."}],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":2,"comment":"It copies the briefing's section headings ('News since your last bulletin:', 'Already reported:') into the bulletin, which breaks format and character.
